research.name: Research Assistant, New York University Shanghai, Shanghai, China
research.summary: Generative Retrieval for Multimodal Recommendation System
highlights: Developed a multimodal framework for sequential recommendation on Amazon datasets. Identified and applied VQ-VAE, RQ-VAE, OPQ to capture discrete behavior patterns, achieving 47.2% improvement in NDCG@10 (0.0339 to 0.0499).
Collaborated with 2 teammates and implemented BPE-inspired partitioning tokenization across item sequences, merging frequent sub-sequences to enhance contextual coherence and representation quality.

research.name: Research Assistant, New York University Shanghai, Shanghai, China
research.summary: Energy-Aware Route Optimization Under Traffic-Light Timing
highlights: Proposed and designed a traffic-aware routing system under real-world map constraints, minimizing energy consumption.

Built an OSM, SUMO, TraCI pipeline and extended Dijkstra's algorithm to multi-objective (time, energy) shortest paths, integrating electric and gasoline vehicle energy models. Achieved 10–15% fuel savings at 2–5% time cost.

projects.name: Center for Data Science, New York University
projects.summary: Efficient Retrosynthesis with Pretrained LM Fine-Tuning
highlights: Trained predictive models for chemical reaction retrosynthesis using SMILES notation, applying an LLM (LlaSMol-Llama2) for dataset reconstruction and augmentation, improving Top-1 Accuracy by 26.2% (0.588 to 0.742).
Explored and employed multiple fine-tuning strategies (encoder freezing, MLP adapters, LoRA) to identify optimal approach with best accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

projects.name: Tandon School of Engineering, New York University
highlights: Self-directed a project to design a 13-table MySQL database populated with 390+ records, supporting multi-league sports with user authentication, draft scheduling, roster management, and trading systems. Engineered a Python backend and HTML/CSS frontend with ACID-compliant transactions, triggers, and stored procedures, integrating full-stack functionality.

work.name: Data Strategy Department, McDonald's China
work.summary: Worked on building and optimizing data infrastructure to support business intelligence and analytics for McDonald's China.
highlights: Spearheaded an internal AI agent for self-service data access, routing natural-language queries to constraint-aware SQL over a catalog spanning 14 business domains, or RAG over internal data maps and documents to generate cited answers.

Initiated and designed a similarity-based sales forecasting algorithm over a combo master-data set normalized across 4 ID levels, quantifying menu-composition to forecast new-combo launch sales from comparable combos.
Managed and validated enterprise database schemas, governing a 203-scenario and 54-interface data map.
Redesigned data dashboards, organizing 500+ financial metrics with structured drill-down paths for self-service analytics.
